card.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 RB or LB is only registering clicks when certain parts of the bumper are pressed or when the button is pressed with too much force repair

source.title: Xbox Elite Controller Series 2 RB or LB is only registering clicks when certain parts of the bumper are pressed or when the button is pressed with too much force repair

symptoms: RB/LB registers only on part of the bumper or with force

claims.statement: If RB or LB only clicks on part of the bumper or with excess force, replace that switch on the blue board.

card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
